visitor.name: Visitor
visitor.personality: Signs in and checks their own session — proves auth end to end

dev.name: Devi Sharma
goals: Get a working flow live without asking anyone for access
dev.description: Wires up the integrations the rest of the company asks for
dev.personality: Impatient with clicking. Wants to duplicate an existing flow and edit two nodes rather than start from an empty canvas.

ola.name: Ola Nkemdirim
goals: Get the queue back to green
ola.description: Watches the run queue and unsticks things
ola.personality: Calm under a pager. Reads the step output before touching anything, and writes down what they did.

sam.name: Sam Whitfield
goals: Find out if the overnight sync ran
sam.description: Depends on flows they did not build and cannot change
sam.personality: Asks precise questions. Wants to know whether last night's run succeeded, not how the flow works.
